svg.title: Trajectory — milestones from 2020 to now
svg.desc: 2020: ukmt senior maths challenge — Silver · national mathematics competition. 2023: computer vision challenge — Winner · ranked #1 at City, University of London. 2024: first-class dissertation — 76% · BTC/USD time-series LSTM MSci Data Science. 2025: cognizant vibe challenge — Winner · led a 9-person grad team to build DreamSense. NOW: senior forward deployed ai · 7im — Building & governing production AI agents. NEXT: uncharted — The next mission.
